name: dev.ucp.common.quote
title: Quote Extension
description: Extends Cart and Checkout with a Business-issued quotation for the current line items. The Buyer may propose a price or ask for one; the Business accepts, declines, defers, or issues a quotation the Buyer accepts by id; an accepted quotation is reflected in the authoritative totals and projected onto the resulting Order.

quote_proposal.title: Quote Proposal
quote_proposal.description: The Buyer's proposal for the current line items. An empty object asks the Business to quote without proposing a price.

subtotal.description: Subtotal the Buyer proposes to pay for the current line items, in ISO 4217 minor units in the Cart or Checkout `currency`, before fulfillment, tax, and fees. Omit to ask for a quotation without proposing a price.

message.description: Buyer note to the Business accompanying the proposal, such as context on quantity or timing. Businesses MUST NOT require this field and MUST NOT require personal data in it; buyer identity travels through `buyer` and identity linking.

quote.title: Quote
quote.description: Quote state for a Cart or Checkout: the Business's current quotation, the lifecycle status of the open cycle, and the Buyer's proposal or acceptance. On a response, an empty object means the Business will consider a proposal and no cycle is open.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the open quote cycle; absent when no cycle is open. Well-known values: `pending` (a proposal was received and the Business has not yet answered), `quoted` (the Business issued a quotation that awaits the Buyer), `accepted` (the quotation was accepted and `totals` reflect it), `declined` (the Business declined the proposal), `expired` (the quotation lapsed before acceptance), `withdrawn` (the Business revoked a quotation before it lapsed). A Platform that receives a value it does not recognize MUST treat no quotation as acceptable and MUST NOT offer to accept one; `totals` remain authoritative.

id.description: Identifier of the Business's current quotation. Unique within the Business and immutable once issued: a quotation with different terms is a new quotation with a new `id`. Present when `status` is `quoted`, `accepted`, or `withdrawn`, and when `expired` follows a quotation. Absent when no quotation has been issued.

subtotal.description: Subtotal the Business quotes for the line items the quotation was issued against, in ISO 4217 minor units in the Cart or Checkout `currency`, before fulfillment, tax, and fees. Present whenever `id` is.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the quotation lapses if not accepted. Required when `status` is `quoted`. After acceptance it records the validity the Buyer accepted under. The Business MAY extend it in place and MUST NOT shorten it.

message.description: Business note accompanying the response, such as the reason a proposal was declined, what to expect while `pending`, or a condition attached to the quotation.

proposal.description: The Buyer's proposal. In a request, submitting it opens a new quote cycle and supersedes any quotation that has not been accepted. In a response, the Business echoes the proposal of the current cycle.

accepted_id.description: ID of the quotation the Buyer accepts: the `id` from the latest response, whose `status` MUST be `quoted`, or the `id` of a quotation this Business issued to this Buyer outside the Cart or Checkout. An update carries at most one of `proposal` and `accepted_id`. Omitted on complete because a quotation is agreed, if at all, before completion. Accepting is a mutation: the Business response is authoritative for all derived state. The Business echoes it on every response while the quotation it names is current, so an `accepted` status without it means the Business accepted the Buyer's proposal outright.

order_quote.title: Order Quote
order_quote.description: The quotation accepted before the Order was placed.

id.description: Identifier of the accepted quotation, as issued on the Cart or Checkout.

subtotal.description: Quoted subtotal the Buyer accepted, in ISO 4217 minor units in the Order `currency`, before fulfillment, tax, and fees.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Quote
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with a quotation for its line items.

quote.description: Quote state for this Cart. A Business includes it when it will consider a proposal for the Cart or a quote cycle is open; its absence means no quotation is available for the Cart in its current state.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Quote
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with a quotation for its line items.

quote.description: Quote state for this Checkout. A Business includes it when it will consider a proposal for the Checkout or a quote cycle is open; its absence means no quotation is available for the Checkout in its current state. Omitted on complete because a quotation is agreed, if at all, before completion.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Accepted Quote
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with the quotation accepted at checkout.

quote.description: The quotation accepted before the Order was placed. The proposal and the lifecycle state are not projected.
